race.comment: CREATOR OF WORLD (3) progressive gelding with his hoof on the till. Had to go back from the outside draw and produced excellent closing splits with a narrow third over 1200m at Kembla Grange. Gets the right run today and expected to go close at start nine. SHE CAN SALSA (9) raced below her best last time when she failed to handle the soft (7) going with a battling seventh over 1600m at Goulburn. Drops in trip with the blinkers and tongue-tie going on. Look for her closing strongly. OVERSHADOW (8) in need of the run first-up when she failed to close off with a battling seventh over 1300m at Hawkesbury in a Super Mdn. Can improve from the low gate as she gets out in trip. DIVINE HEIGHTS (11) was unwanted in betting on debut with a surprise on-pace second over 1300m at Kembla Grange. Can come on from that performance and give a ton of cheek again.
